messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Jenna Park <jenna@hawkcloud.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: QBR: Roadmap owners, decision matrix & timeline alignment

Team —

As we prep the QBR deck for HawkCloud next week, I want a tight, owner-driven view of the product & engineering items that touch their launch window. The ask is simple: confirm owners, current status, decision points, and the earliest acceptable contingency for each risk. I attached the latest QBR_Roadmap_Summary_v3.pdf and a RACI template (RACI_QBR_owner_matrix.xlsx).

Key outcomes I need by EOD Wednesday (05/12):
- Finalized owner for each line item in the RACI (product/eng/ops)
- One-sentence current status and blocker for each item
- Decision deadlines (hard cut / soft cut) for canary / GA

Quick priorities for HawkCloud:
1) Dedicated inference pool for their EU customers (seq length 2.5k) — model onboarding + perf validation (Karthik)
2) Canary rollout gating for streaming responses (Soojin)
3) Cost/perf tuning playbook for embedding-heavy pipelines (Laura + Marcus)

Please update the spreadsheet and reply in-thread with any unresolved dependencies so I can escalate before Thursday leadership sync. Jenna — fyi, we're aligning owners; we'll confirm the canary window by Thursday.

Thanks,

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product & Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachment: QBR_Roadmap_Summary_v3.pdf (summary deck, 9 slides)
Attachment: RACI_QBR_owner_matrix.xlsx (RACI template to be filled)

Vivek —

Acknowledged. I started filling the RACI sheet for the Dedicated inference pool. Short status: model onboarding is 70% (quantization + perf kernels outstanding), infra validation in progress but blocked on the EU test harness (integration tests failing intermittently).

Blockers and proposed mitigations:
- EU test harness flakiness (root cause: network egress rules) — Eng infra (Marcus) to triage; tentative resolution target 05/13.
- Quant kernels for 2.5k context still under perf tuning — I'll bring a mini-playbook to the canary gating call; soft cut = 06/01, hard cut = 06/15.

I'll upload the partial RACI by EOD and add explicit decision dates.

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. Director, Inference

Adding a few specifics on the streaming canary gating:

- Current status: streaming feature branch merged; quiescent in staging for 48h with no service-impacting failures. Load tests show tail latency spike under specific multi-tenant patterns.
- Risk: tail-latency under 95th–99th percentile scenarios; mitigation: progressive CPU pinning + KV cache prioritization.
- Decision dates: soft canary start 05/20 (limited customers), canary health review 05/26, GA decision 06/08 (hard cut 06/15).

Action items assigned:
- Soojin: owner for canary gating, build checklist for health signals
- Marcus: infra validation and pinning playbook
- Laura: customer-facing rollback messaging and SLOs for HawkCloud

I updated the RACI with these owner assignments. Marcus — can you confirm you can run the infra validation by 05/13?

— Soojin
Director, Product Ops

Subject: Re: QBR: Roadmap owners, decision matrix & timeline alignment — consolidated state

Team — consolidated update for Vivek / leadership pack. I pulled the latest RACI and the summary deck; notes below reflect what I'll include in the QBR slides. If anything here is incorrect or missing, flag immediately (reply-all).

Consolidated items (what we'll present to HawkCloud):
- Dedicated inference pool (Owner: Karthik Iyer) — Status: onboarding 70%, infra test harness flakiness is the single highest operational risk. Decision cadence: soft cut 06/01, hard cut 06/15.
- Streaming responses canary (Owner: Soojin Lee) — Status: staging quiescent, tail-latency mitigations in play. Canary start 05/20, canary review 05/26.
- Embedding cost/perf playbook (Owners: Laura Bennett + Marcus Lin) — Status: draft playbook under review; will include initial 3 tuning recipes for HawkCloud's pipeline by 05/17.

Open escalation items for leadership:
1) If EU test harness flakiness persists past 05/13, request temporary escalation to Cloud Networking to reserve brief dedicated windows for repeatable tests.
2) If quant kernel perf shows <85% of target by 05/25, we recommend shifting HawkCloud EU canary to a limited cohort while continuing perf work.

Attachments included in the deck: QBR_Roadmap_Summary_v3.pdf (summary slides) and RACI_QBR_owner_matrix.xlsx (final draft).

Jenna — we'll confirm the canary cohort mechanics after leadership review. Procurement — please note tentative timelines for contract milestone A (canary) and milestone B (GA) in HubSpot 94721.

Thanks — I will merge any last edits by 5pm today.

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success — Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference
